from semver import compare, sort_versions

def test_semver():
    test_cases = [
        # (a, b, expected_compare, description)
        ("1.0.0", "2.0.0", -1, "Basic major increment"),
        ("2.1.0", "2.1.0", 0, "Equal versions"),
        ("2.1.1", "2.1.0", 1, "Patch increment"),
        ("v1.2.3", "1.2.3", 0, "Prefix 'v' handling"),
        ("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3", -1, "Pre-release vs release"),
        ("1.2.3", "1.2.3-alpha", 1, "Release vs pre-release"),
        ("1.2.3-alpha.1", "1.2.3-alpha.beta", -1, "Numeric vs non-numeric pre-release"),
        ("1.2.3-beta.2", "1.2.3-beta.11", -1, "Numeric comparison (2 < 11)"),
        ("1.2.3+build.1", "1.2.3+build.2", 0, "Build metadata doesn't affect order"),
        ("1.2.3-alpha.1", "1.2.3-alpha.1+build.100", 0, "Pre-release equality with build info"),
        ("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha.1", -1, "Pre-release prefix comparison"),
    ]

    for a, b, expected, desc in test_cases:
        res = compare(a, b)
        if res != expected:
            raise AssertionError(f"Failed: {desc} | compare({a}, {b}) expected {expected}, got {res}")

    # Sorting tests
    versions = [
        "1.0.0-alpha.1", "1.0.0-alpha.beta", "1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0", "1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha.1+build.1", "v1.0.0"
    ]
    # Expected order: 
    # 1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0-alpha.1 < 1.0.0-alpha.beta < 1.0.0-beta < 1.0.0
    # Note: v1.0.0 is equal to 1.0.0
    # Stable sort: 1.0.0-alpha.1+build.1 and 1.0.0-alpha.1 are equal in comparison but preserve order
    
    sorted_v = sort_versions(versions)
    
    # Quick check of the sorted order property
    for i in range(len(sorted_v) - 1):
        if compare(sorted_v[i], sorted_v[i+1]) > 0:
            raise AssertionError(f"Sort failed: {sorted_v[i]} comes before {sorted_v[i+1]}")

    # Check ValueError
    try:
        compare("1.0", "1.0.0")
        raise AssertionError("Failed to raise ValueError for invalid version (missing patch)")
    except ValueError:
        pass

    try:
        compare("01.1.1", "1.1.1")
        raise AssertionError("Failed to raise ValueError for leading zero in major")
    except ValueError:
        pass

    print("All tests passed successfully!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_semver()
